title: Multimodal EEG and fNIRS Biosignal Acquisition during Motor Imagery Tasks in Patients with Orthopedic Impairment
description: Raw multimodal recordings of 18-channel EEG and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) from seven participants with orthopedic impairment performing motor imagery tasks. Each participant completed three sessions of 40 trials, with four motor imagery tasks (reach, twist, lift, grasp) presented in random order. The dataset supports research on multimodal brain-computer interfaces for people with motor impairments.
methods_description: Each trial began with a 3 s fixation cross, followed by a 4 s visual cue and 3 s of a gray ready screen to eliminate afterimages. Participants then performed the imagined movement for 5 s. Each of the three sessions comprised 40 trials with four motor imagery tasks in random order.
